label: S4_Salidas
code_lines: ﻿/*PROC DATASETS; POR CIERRE 2019 SE DEJA ESTE AJUSTE AFUERA PARA PODER INCORPORARLO EN EL INDICADOR PARA ARMONIZAR LOS DIVIDENDOS Y EN UNA ETAPA ANTERIOR LA PARTE DEL AJUSTE DE LOS DEPÓSITOS
PROC SQL; DELETE FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI WHERE FUENTE='AJ_GS';QUIT;
proc sql; delete from TABLAS.BD_CTSI where año>2025 /*and trim>3*/;quit;
/*GENERA BASE DE SALIDA PARA ARCHIVO SINTESIS*/

SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T4.N_SCN AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T3.C_SI AS C_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.N_SI AS N_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.C_SI_publ AS C_SI_publ_C_AGENTE,
T3.N_SI_publ AS N_SI_publ_C_AGENTE, T3.C_SI_SCN AS C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T3.N_SI_SCN AS N_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, SUM(T1.DATO) AS DATO,
T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1 AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1 AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN,
T1.FUENTE,T1.PROC, T4.C_SCN_N0,T4.N_SCN_N0,T3.C_SI_SCN_N0 AS C_CAG_N0, T3.N_SI_SCN_N0 AS N_CAG_N0
GROUP BY CALCULATED MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN,T4.N_SCN,T3.C_SI,T3.N_SI,T3.C_SI_publ,
T3.N_SI_publ, T3.C_SI_SCN, T3.N_SI_SCN, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN,
/*proc sql; delete from SALIDA_WTW where año>2024 ;quit;*/
/*GENERA BASE DE SALIDA PARA ARCHIVO NOTA*/

SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T4.N_SCN AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T3.C_SI AS C_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.N_SI AS N_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.C_SI_publ AS C_SI_publ_C_AGENTE,
T3.N_SI_publ AS N_SI_publ_C_AGENTE, T3.C_SI_SCN AS C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T3.N_SI_SCN AS N_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 AS DATO,
T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1 AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1 AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN
GROUP BY CALCULATED MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN,T4.N_SCN,T3.C_SI,T3.N_SI,T3.C_SI_publ,
T3.N_SI_publ, T3.C_SI_SCN, T3.N_SI_SCN, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN;
